'''Col''' is a horse handler in [[Valan Luca]]'s menagerie. He is [[Tairen]], bent-nosed and heavy-shouldered with a thick mustache. 
==Activities==
[[Mat]] sees him gambling with another horse handler and then ducking out of the way when he and [[Egeanin]] pass, as the last man to be overly suggestive to her had a knife drawn on him.
